conclusion.reason: The structural definition of a and its restricted section4.2 redefinition create a real specification gap for the aerodynamic-to-structural sample transfer. Eq67 points to the interval force-point geometry while Eq56 uses an endpoint average of distributed load. The inspected equations do not give the missing nodal aerodynamic force reconstruction or one-sided value convention for piecewise-constant Gamma. Internal force conservation alone cannot resolve this gap.

source_references.claim: Continuous force and moment balance define distributed f and m separately from concentrated loads.
Section 2.1 defines subscript a as the simple average between i and i+1 stations.

Structural balance uses f_a*Delta_s and m_a*Delta_s. These equations are conservative for the discrete loads supplied. Conservation does not identify how the aerodynamic force density was sampled or recovered.
Pointwise circulation is per structural interval; the alternative is a continuous sine representation.
Kutta-Joukowsky distributed lift is rho*Gamma*(V cross s_hat), with velocity evaluated at the bound-vortex location rh.v. defined later.
Vortex segment strength samples the Fourier mode at the Glauert midpoint, or is piecewise constant for the pointwise representation. The a redefinition is explicitly restricted to this section.
The bound-vortex midpoint rh.v., where lift force is defined to be located, uses the Glauert-midpoint ra and quarter-chord offset.
Section 5.1 obtains total force by summing the structural equations and implementing the equivalent ground reaction. It does not restate a unique aerodynamic-to-structural recovery.
Total reported lift includes both circulatory lift and profile drag projected normal to freestream; therefore rho*V*integral(Gamma) need not equal the total CL.

Unsteady extension derives total moment with the arithmetic spatial midpoint r_a=(r_i+r_(i+1))/2; force/couple transfer must preserve the resulting global wrench. This algebra still does not specify aerodynamic f_i recovery.
Current implementation forms integrated interval circulation forces from sampled Gamma, local velocity and interval length, plus drag/apparent contributions.
Current source coupled transfer offsets the interval couple from aerodynamic mesh.rm to the structural spatial midpoint before symmetric endpoint transfer.

independent_identities.harmonic_endpoint_mean: [sin(k theta_i)+sin(k theta_(i+1))]/2 = sin(k theta_mid)*cos(k Delta_theta/2). Holds separately on every interval, including nonuniform theta.
independent_identities.uniform_full_span_sine_integrals: For theta_j=j*pi/N, s=R*cos(theta), Gamma=sum_(k=1)^K A_k sin(k theta), K<N: midpoint sum M=sum Gamma(theta_mid)*Delta_s = R*N*sin(pi/(2N))*A_1; endpoint trapezoid T=cos(pi/(2N))*M; continuous integral C=pi*R*A_1/2. These follow from discrete sine orthogonality, independent of a circulation solver or archived targets.
independent_identities.constant_freestream_circulatory_lift: For the straight unswept saved SA1 field, the velocity component parallel to freestream equals V at every retained sample to7.11e-15. Thus CL_circulatory=rho*V*sum(Gamma_i*Delta_s_i)/qS, independently of induced velocity normal to wind. The saved profile-force projection supplies the difference from total CL.
independent_identities.mean_product_is_not_product_means: mean(Gamma*V) - mean(Gamma)*mean(V) = (Gamma_R-Gamma_L)*(V_R-V_L)/4, componentwise. Therefore replacing sampled Gamma alone is not a general implementation of endpoint-averaged f= rho*Gamma*(V cross s_hat).
independent_identities.conservative_interval_wrench: Given integrated interval force P at aerodynamic position r_theta and intrinsic couple C, structural midpoint r_bar=(r_L+r_R)/2 requires midpoint couple C_bar=C+(r_theta-r_bar) cross P. Symmetric endpoint forces P/2 and couples C_bar/2 then give sum F=P and sum(r cross F+couple)=r_theta cross P+C for any reference origin. This identity tests transfer conservation, not the choice of P.

meaningful_test_proposals.name: Harmonic quadrature oracle
meaningful_test_proposals.construction: Prescribe Gamma=A1*sin(theta)+A3*sin(3theta) on a fixed cosine mesh with constant freestream, unit density, zero profile drag and zero section moment. Compare the integrated force against the independently derived M/T/C formula corresponding to an explicitly declared transfer policy. Use two resolutions, not archived target matching.
meaningful_test_proposals.discriminates: Detects an unannounced change between interval sampled loads, endpoint averages, or exact sine integration; does not assume a shared production summation is correct.

meaningful_test_proposals.name: Endpoint product averaging
meaningful_test_proposals.construction: Use unequal endpoint Gamma and unequal nonparallel endpoint velocity/frame fields. Check the average of the complete endpoint Kutta-Joukowsky vectors, not Gamma average times midpoint velocity.
meaningful_test_proposals.discriminates: A source-endpoint-average implementation must retain covariance/product terms; matching uniform velocity alone is insufficient.

meaningful_test_proposals.name: Noncentral force-point wrench transfer
meaningful_test_proposals.construction: Prescribe arbitrary noncollinear r_L,r_R,P,C and a nonmidpoint r_theta. Independently compare force and global moment before/after transfer about two arbitrary origins.
meaningful_test_proposals.discriminates: Detects loss or double counting of the aerodynamic-to-structural spatial lever arm. Does not establish original force quadrature.

meaningful_test_proposals.name: Piecewise circulation trace policy
meaningful_test_proposals.construction: Two adjacent intervals with deliberately different constant circulations. Require an explicit recovery/one-sided rule at the common node before claiming nodal trapezoidal loading.
meaningful_test_proposals.discriminates: Eq153 alone gives interval constants and does not select unique nodal Gamma at a jump.

actionable_findings: The saved same-basis endpoint-trapezoid diagnostic lowers circulatory CL by about4.47e-6 (N200) or1.12e-6 (N400), far smaller than the roughly8.40e-5 total-CL discrepancy. This rejects only that narrow fixed-Gamma transfer change as a complete explanation.

Do not silently replace current loading with nodal Gamma trapezoids: a full source-consistent alternative needs a documented nodal velocity/frame and circulation trace rule plus a conservative moment transfer.

Seek an explicit primary discretization statement or v5.96 implementation showing the aerodynamic f_a construction. Until then report the load-transfer assumption; do not describe either rule as proven historical behavior.
